statement: Two source IPs produced 10 invalid-password attempts against 5 users.
conclusion_use: Confirms distributed password-spray behavior; it does not prove any password was correct.

statement: For USER-001, four later sign-ins from 198.51.100.77 recorded correct primary authentication before MFA: 2 denied and 2 timed out.
conclusion_use: Confirms the actor possessed or successfully used the correct password by 01:44 UTC.

statement: A successful interactive sign-in occurred at 2026-06-18T01:49:10Z using Microsoft Authenticator number matching from an unapproved anonymous-proxy IP and unmanaged/unknown device context.
conclusion_use: Confirms successful primary authentication, MFA completion, Conditional Access satisfaction and session creation; does not by itself prove user intent.

statement: The compliant-device policy returned reportOnlyFailure while enforced MFA policies returned success.
conclusion_use: Report-only failure did not block the sign-in and must not be described as enforcement.

statement: Session SESSION-001 linked one interactive sign-in, three non-interactive token events and 4 M365 audit events.
source_link: Session ID across sign-in and M365 audit records
conclusion_use: Confirms session continuity and follow-on activity; non-interactive events are not additional user MFA approvals.

statement: Correlation CORRELATION-001 links the successful sign-in, 4 platform risk records and 1 security-information registration audit event(s).
conclusion_use: Strengthens cross-source linkage without treating every nearby event as the same transaction.

statement: A separate IMAP/ROPC sign-in from the second attack IP was blocked by an enforced legacy-authentication policy and issued no session/token.
conclusion_use: This is a separate unsuccessful attempt, not part of the successful session.

statement: The platform emitted 4 risk detections linked to the successful request/correlation.
conclusion_use: Corroborating leads only; risk labels are not the proof of compromise.

statement: User confirmed the successful sign-in and follow-on actions were unauthorized.
conclusion_use: Provides the authorization boundary required to distinguish suspicious success from confirmed unauthorized use.

statement: The preceding Sydney location was an approved corporate VPN exit, so the travel-speed calculation is not proof of physical travel.
conclusion_use: Suppresses impossible-travel overclaim while leaving the Bucharest sign-in suspicious on independent evidence.

statement: Ground-truth classification is 'Confirmed account compromise' and matches the independent assessment.
conclusion_use: Used only as a post-assessment validation check, not as primary evidence.

statement: Authenticator approving-device/GPS telemetry and raw token material are absent by design.
conclusion_use: Telemetry cannot identify the physical approver or prove token theft/replay.

statement: Detailed internal Conditional Access condition traces and byte-for-byte portal export fidelity are not modeled.
conclusion_use: Exact reasons for every notApplied result cannot be asserted beyond the available policy result.
